patterns.regex: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon|docker daemon is not running|Error response from daemon
patterns.suggestion: Start Docker Desktop or run: open -a Docker (macOS) or sudo systemctl start docker (Linux)

patterns.regex: bind: address already in use|port is already allocated|listen tcp.*bind: address already in use
patterns.suggestion: Find and kill the process: lsof -ti:<port> | xargs kill -9 (replace <port> with the port number from the error)
Check the error message above, fix the issue in your Tiltfile, then run: tilt up

patterns.regex: failed to solve|executor failed running|BUILD FAILED|docker build failed
patterns.suggestion: Check the build logs above for the specific error. Common fixes: 1) Check Dockerfile syntax 2) Ensure all files referenced in COPY exist 3) Run: tilt doctor to verify Docker is working
Check service logs in Tilt UI (click the failing service). Look for: 1) Missing env vars 2) Database connection issues 3) Port conflicts

patterns.regex: NATS connection|nats:.*error|Failed to connect to NATS
patterns.message: Cannot connect to NATS message broker
patterns.suggestion: NATS should start automatically. If not: 1) Check if NATS container is running: docker ps | grep nats 2) Restart with: tilt trigger nats
Common fixes: 1) Wait 30s for database to start 2) Check database container: docker ps | grep postgres 3) Run migrations: cd <service> && bunx prisma migrate deploy

patterns.regex: Module not found|Cannot find module|import.*not found
patterns.suggestion: Try: 1) Install dependencies: bun install 2) Build shared packages: bun run build:shared 3) If import is from scoped packages, ensure the package is built
Fix file permissions: 1) For port issues, use a port above 1024 2) For file issues: chmod +x <file> 3) Docker issues: check Docker Desktop permissions
Service may be slow to start. Try: 1) Wait longer 2) Check resource usage: docker stats 3) Restart the service: tilt trigger <service-name>

fallback.suggestion: Run 'tdk doctor' to check your environment, or check the Tilt UI at http://localhost:10350 for more details
